headline_of_the_week.title: The largest round ever raised by an EU headquartered company led by a female founder and chief executive
headline_of_the_week.summary: Helene Huby's The Exploration Company closed a USD 450 million Series C, the largest ever by a European space company and the largest by an EU headquartered company led by a female founder and CEO.

headlines.title: The Exploration Company closes USD 450 million Series C co-led by Bessemer, Atomico and the EQT managed Scaleup Europe Fund
headlines.summary: Founder and CEO Helene Huby raised USD 450 million, taking total funding since 2021 to about USD 680 million against more than USD 2 billion in contracts and commitments, with 550 employees. Balderton, Plural, Cherry and Red River West also participated.

headlines.title: Norway's DNB lists DNB Fund Women's Health, reported as the first women's health equity fund from a major bank
headlines.summary: Norway's largest bank launched a global thematic equity fund investing across pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, treatments, medtech, healthcare services and consumer markets tied to women's health. Portfolio manager and physician Anesa Mulabecirovic Sahnoun runs it and argues women's health is not a niche but a large share of the health economy.

headlines.title: Euno raises USD 23 million Series A led by N47 with Wiz, Cyera and Eon founders backing it
headlines.summary: Co-founder and CEO Sarah Levy raised a USD 23 million Series A for the enterprise AI context platform, taking total funding to USD 29 million across San Francisco and Tel Aviv.

headlines.title: The Gender Index finds Australian women start businesses in numbers then hit a scaling cliff costing more than AUD 100 billion a year
headlines.summary: The first national study of its kind reports women at 42.2 per cent of new business founders while very few scale. The forgone combined wages and government tax revenue exceeds AUD 100 billion a year, alongside roughly 745,000 jobs that are never created.

headlines.title: Cherub raises USD 4.5 million pre-seed from Baukunst, Slauson and Co and Ghost Angels
headlines.summary: Co-founders Jaclyn Johnson and Angeline Vuong raised USD 4.5 million for the marketplace that matches founders with angel investors. A company whose entire product is helping founders raise capital just raised capital itself.
